LB_SELECTED
       Triggered when the system selects a pool member.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggered when the system selects a pool member.

Examples
	when LB_SELECTED {
	    if { [IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.1] } {
		# Apply a snat
		snat VIPsnat
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the event.  @BIGIP-9.2.2 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
